about: A simple but powerful self-hosted personal finance tracker.

prs.title: Monthly payments on the 31st stay on the 31st
prs.broken: A monthly recurring transaction on the 29th to 31st moved to the 28th for good after February, so rent and projected balances drifted.
prs.changed: Each next date now goes back to the original day when the month has it.
prs.matters: Budgets and future balances use the right dates all year.
